The sun is shining on a dusty road;

And in his hand he holds a whip made out of leather strong
Which cracks like thunder if you strike him wrong.

author: stephen_crane
text:
THE HAPPY PRINCE

When I was a little boy in central London, there used to be two lamps at each corner of Whitehall; and they always shone like stars, for they were really made of fine cut glass, with many sides, so that we saw our faces reflected in them whenever it rained or hailed. And when you looked up at these great lights from your carriage window on dark nights, as my brother did one night, he said suddenly, "Look! How bright those eyes are!"

"Yes," said his father, who sat beside him, "they look very much alive."
